stylevana.note: Stylevana's current official shipping-destination list is used because the standard Awin feed does not provide product-level shipping destinations. Individual products, remote areas or checkout rules may still have destination restrictions.

dowinx-eu.note: Dowinx EU states that it ships to approximately 75% of European countries and lists the destinations shown here as examples. The country list is not exhaustive, so Worth It does not present it as a complete country count.

fntcase.note: FNTCASE states that it ships to most European and North American countries, but it does not publish a complete country list. Worth It therefore shows the regional coverage without inventing an exact country count.

giftlab.note: Giftlab states that it provides worldwide shipping and international orders. The listed countries are destinations explicitly documented across its current official shipping/support pages and are representative rather than exhaustive; checkout remains the final authority.

personalhour.note: PersonalHour states that it ships to all 50 U.S. states, including Hawaii. Freight cost, transit time, carrier availability and delivery options can vary by region and product.

alison-us-ca.note: Alison courses are digital services rather than physical shipped products. Worth It therefore reports worldwide digital access instead of inventing physical shipping destinations.
